description: This Scala source file defines the FetchedDataPool class, which manages a pool of FetchedData objects grouped by CacheKey for Kafka consumer data caching within Spark. It includes methods for acquiring, releasing, invalidating, and cleaning up cached data, as well as internal classes and objects for cache management.

classes.name: FetchedDataPool
classes.description: Manages a cache of FetchedData objects grouped by CacheKey, with background eviction thread.

classes.name: CachedFetchedData
classes.description: Wrapper for FetchedData with metadata for cache management.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CachedFetchedData for a given CacheKey and desired start offset.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a specific CacheKey.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a FetchedData back into the cache for a given CacheKey.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service managing eviction.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cache and restarts the eviction thread.

methods.name: removeIdleFetchedData
methods.description: Removes expired, idle CachedFetchedData entries based on last release time.
